findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scrape_page, search_web, search_places, search_news, search_walmart, search_ebay, search_zillow, search_x, search_youtube, youtube_transcript · Public sink: search_x · Destructive: scrape_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scrape_page, search_web, search_places, search_news, search_walmart, search_ebay, search_zillow, search_x, search_youtube, youtube_transcript · Public sink: search_x · Destructive: scrape_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
